BTC.note: Sold 2 Nov 2026 – no longer held; still watched for MSTR: Binance exchange hack (95% covered) and BTCPay drains on old versions; Bitcoin itself unaffected
BTC.detail: Bob sold his Bitcoin fund on 2 Nov 2026; this is watched only because MSTR holds Bitcoin. Binance (an exchange) lost about US$6.3bn on 29-30 Oct to North Korea-linked hackers; it was not a flaw in Bitcoin. Binance says about 95% is replaced (BTC fully backed), withdrawals reopened in phases from 1 Nov (net outflow about US$3.6bn, 2.1% of assets), and its full reserves proof is due 3 Nov (UTC). The attacker's 18,270 stolen BTC have not moved. BTCPay Server, merchant payment software, says hot-wallet drains hit servers on version 2.4.1 or older; latest 2.4.7 has no credible reports; losses not disclosed. This hits merchants' own servers, not the Bitcoin network. Quantum: estimates keep falling but remain theoretical. Strategy's custodians (Coinbase, Anchorage, Fidelity) are not affected.

TSLA.detail: No confirmed Tesla breach. A Sept 2026 hacking-forum claim is unverified.

MSTR.detail: Strategy itself was not hacked. The Binance hack only moved its share price through Bitcoin.

SEMI.detail: No breaches at SEMI's top holdings. Intel's Israel factory explosion is an operations issue, not a security one.
